title: Timeline project
description: project.json in a Timeline project folder. Media files (audio, images, video) sit in the same folder and are named by relative path. Times are in seconds. Only "sequences" is required at the top. Every clip on a video track needs "start" and "duration", and a program clip needs "dsl"; an audio clip needs "mediaId". Other fields have a default. Ids are optional: a track, clip, transition or marker without one gets an id from its place, such as "main/V1/2". Give a clip an id when a transition names it.

mainSequenceId.description: The sequence that opens and exports. Defaults to the first one.

media.description: Media files keyed by id. Audio clips name them in "mediaId", and so do image and video clips.

sequences.description: Sequences keyed by id. A sequence clip nests one sequence inside another.

effects.description: Custom effects: Noisemaker portable effects, keyed by the name programs call them by. A program reaches one with user on its search line (search synth, filter, user) and then .name(). Definitions are data; no code from a project runs.

path.description: Relative to the project folder, such as "media/song.flac". No "..".

kind.description: Defaults from the extension: wav, mp3, m4a, aac, ogg, opus and flac are audio; png, jpg, webp, gif, svg and avif are images; mp4, m4v, mov, webm and mkv are video.

name.description: Defaults to the file name without its extension.

type.description: MIME type; defaults from the extension.

duration.description: Length of the file, used as the default length of clips that play it.

width.description: Pixel width of an image or video.

height.description: Pixel height of an image or video.

hasAudio.description: Whether a video has sound an audio clip can play.

bpm.description: Tempo of the beat grid. A bar lasts 60 / bpm * beatsPerBar seconds.

audioSensitivity.description: Scales what audio() reads from the mix.

tracks.description: Video tracks, bottom first: tracks[0] is V1 and later tracks draw over it. Defaults to three empty tracks.

audioTracks.description: Audio tracks. In a program, audio(..., channel: N) reads track N alone (channel: 1 is the first); without a channel it reads the mix. Defaults to two empty tracks.

post.description: The post chain: one program that every finished frame passes through. Its media() step reads the frame.

preset.description: A post preset: clean, cinema, industrial, vhs, dream, datamosh, print or lofi. Without "dsl" the chain runs the preset's program.

dsl.description: A custom post program; its media() step reads the finished frame.

name.description: Defaults to V1, V2 and so on.

type.description: Defaults to "sequence" with sequenceId, "text" with text, "image" or "video" (by the media's kind) with mediaId, otherwise "program".

offset.description: Seconds into the program's or nested sequence's own time, or into a video file, where the clip begins.

dsl.description: A Noisemaker DSL program; required for program clips. media() reads the tracks beneath the clip.

loop.description: The program's loop length in seconds: its time runs from 0 to this, then repeats.

sequenceId.description: For a sequence clip, the sequence it plays.

blend.description: How the clip combines with the tracks below it.

tint.description: Display colour of the clip on the timeline.

mediaId.description: For an image or video clip, a key of the project's "media".

fit.description: How an image or video fills the frame before its scale applies; none shows it at its own pixel size.

loopVideo.description: A video clip longer than its file repeats it instead of holding the last frame.

x.description: Horizontal position as a fraction of the frame width: 0 is the left edge, 1 the right. On a program or nested sequence it moves the whole picture's centre.

y.description: Vertical position as a fraction of the frame height: 0 is the top, 1 the bottom.

scale.description: Size multiplier; 1 is the clip's natural size in the frame. On a program or nested sequence it zooms the whole picture.

enter.description: How a graphic arrives. Text defaults to fade; images and video to none. A string is taken as the preset.

exit.description: How a graphic leaves, ending at the clip's end.

text.description: The words of a text clip; \n starts a new line, and long lines wrap at maxWidth.

font.description: A family on the Noise Factor font service (fonts.noisefactor.io), such as Inter, Space Grotesk, Playfair Display, JetBrains Mono, Orbitron or Bungee.

size.description: Text height as a fraction of the frame height.

lineHeight.description: Line spacing as a multiple of the size.

letterSpacing.description: Extra space between letters as a fraction of the size.

align.description: Alignment of the lines; the block is anchored at x by its left edge, centre or right edge.

maxWidth.description: Wrap width as a fraction of the frame width.

background.description: A CSS colour for a box behind the text, or null for none.

keys.description: Keyframes. Each property holds its value before the first key and after the last, and eases between keys.

backgroundPaddingX.description: Horizontal padding of the text background, as a multiple of the text size.

backgroundPaddingY.description: Vertical padding of the text background, as a multiple of the text size.

backgroundRadius.description: Corner radius of the text background, as a multiple of the text size.

width.description: Stroke width as a multiple of the text size.

outline.description: An optional outline around the text glyphs. Null turns it off.

shadow.description: An optional text shadow. Blur and offsets are multiples of the text size. Null turns it off.

visualClip.description: A clip on a video track. Program clips run a Noisemaker DSL program; a program that reads media() reads the composite of the tracks beneath it. Sequence clips nest a sequence. Text, image and video clips are graphics: drawn with transparency over the tracks beneath at a position, scale and rotation, with enter and exit motion.

transition.description: A transition on the cut between two adjacent clips on one track. Without "from" it fades "to" in from black; without "to" it fades "from" out to black.

preset.description: A transition from the library, such as dissolve, luma, glitch, flash, iris, wipe, hexagons or refract.

dsl.description: A custom transition program; empty uses the preset's.

name.description: Defaults to A1, A2 and so on.

muted.description: Silences the track; programs still read it.

duck.description: Dip this whole track while another audio track sounds, such as music under a voice. The dip is an exact curve built from where the other track is louder than threshold (or, with detect: clips, from where its clips are).

under.description: Name or id of the audio track whose clips trigger the dip.

depth.description: How far it dips, in dB.

attack.description: Seconds it takes to dip, ending as a clip starts.

release.description: Seconds it takes to come back after a clip ends.

hold.description: Gaps in the other track shorter than this stay dipped, so pauses between lines do not pump.

threshold.description: The other track counts as sounding above this level, in dB.

detect.description: signal dips where the other track sounds; clips dips for the whole of each of its clips.

mediaId.description: A key of the project's "media": an audio file, or a video whose sound plays.

duration.description: Defaults to the file's length when media lists it, otherwise to the end of the sequence.

offset.description: Seconds into the file where the clip begins.

keys.description: Volume keyframes: gain over time, linear, multiplied with the fades.

preset.description: type reveals text a letter at a time; on an image or video it fades.

ease.description: An easing curve named like GSAP's: none, or power1 to power4, sine, expo, circ or back, followed by .in, .out or .inOut (power3.out). Enter defaults to power3.out, exit to power2.in.
Shapes the change into this key from the key before, named like GSAP eases (power3.out, expo.inOut, none).

effect.description: A folder path holding definition.json, glsl/<program>.glsl and optionally wgsl/<program>.wgsl, or the same inline.

path.description: Relative to the project folder, such as effects/flipTone.

definition.description: A portable effect definition: globals (its parameters) and passes, each naming a shader program with its inputs and outputs. Like Noisemaker's own effects, a filter's pass reads inputTex and writes outputTex.

shaders.description: Shader source per program: { program: { glsl, wgsl } }.
